content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IRPL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.ircon.org. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IRPL recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the IRPL Finance Assistant and Company Secretary posts is 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this IRPL recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Finance Assistant and Company Secretary positions in Ircon Renewable Power.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Finance Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Finance Assistant post, candidates need to have a B. Com, M. Com, or CA Intermediate / ICAI(CMA) Intermediate qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IRPL recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Company Secretary post will receive a salary of Rs. 55,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this IRPL recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the official address.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for IRPL recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the IRPL recruitment includes a Written Exam followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official website of Ircon Renewable Power?
faq.answer: The official website of Ircon Renewable Power is www.ircon.org.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this IRPL recruitment is IRPL/C02/2026.
